metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Palm Springs, California higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Palm Springs, California (define as Point or small Polygon) - For 2017 comparison: July 15-21, 2017 (specific week) - For baseline: July 15-21 across 2001-2010 (same calendar dates) - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) - use MOD11A2 (8-day composite) or daily LST - MODIS LST is standard for this type of analysis 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST products already have quality flags; filter by QA - No cloud masking needed for LST retrieval (LST band already accounts for atmospheric effects) - But check for valid pixels (QC flag) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid result: LST in Kelvin (~280-320K for desert in summer, ~307-315K for Palm Springs in July) - Invalid: None, NaN, or temperature >400K or <200K - Valid Zero doesn't apply to temperature - Check pixel count post-filtering to detect C2 (no valid pixels) - If collection is empty (size==0), try fallback or output C1 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Palm Springs, California const palmSprings = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.5466, 33.8303]); const bufferGeom = palmSprings.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // Define date ranges const jul2017_start = '2017-07-15'; const jul2017_end = '2017-07-21'; // Baseline period: July 15-21 for years 2001-2010 const baselineYears = [2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010]; // Acquire 2017 LST data const col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterDate(jul2017_start, jul2017_end) .filterBounds(bufferGeom); const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); print(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2017 === 0) { print("No LST data for July 2017."); print("C1"); return; } // Acquire baseline LST data (2001-2010, same calendar dates) let baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection([]); for (let year of baselineYears) { const startDate = `${year}-07-15`; const endDate = `${year}-07-21`; const yearCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(bufferGeom); baselineCol = baselineCol.merge(yearCol); } const sizeBaseline = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); print(`Baseline Images (2001-2010): ${sizeBaseline}`); if (sizeBaseline === 0) { print("No baseline LST data available."); print("C1"); return; } // Extract LST band (night LST in Kelvin, divide by 100 to get actual K) const lst2017 = col2017.select('LST_Night_1km').median().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius const lstBaseline = baselineCol.select('LST_Night_1km').median().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Calculate statistics const stats2017 = lst2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const statsBaseline = lstBaseline.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bufferGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val2017 = stats2017['LST_Night_1km']; const valBaseline = statsBaseline['LST_Night_1km']; print(`2017 LST (Jul 15-21): ${(val2017 !== null ? val2017.toFixed(2) : 'null')}°C`); print(`Baseline LST (2001-2010): ${(valBaseline !== null ? valBaseline.toFixed(2) : 'null')}°C`); // Validate results if (val2017 === null || valBaseline === null) { print("LST calculation returned null."); print("C3"); return; } if (isNaN(val2017) || isNaN(valBaseline)) { print("LST values are NaN."); print("C3"); return; } // Check for physically unreasonable values (desert night temps should be -20 to +30°C) if (val2017 < -50 || val2017 > 50 || valBaseline < -50 || valBaseline > 50) { print("LST values out of reasonable range."); print("C3"); return; } // Compare const diff = val2017 - valBaseline; print(`Difference (2017 - Baseline): ${diff.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (val2017 > valBaseline) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
